## What it is

This project exmaines house values and mortgage trends across 18 U.S. metro areas from 2002 to 2011. I looked at whether housing markets differet by city and whether house values were related to mortgage performance.

## What I did

- Combined city-level house-value data with quarterly mortgage-performnace data.
- Used R to clean data, create visualizations, and run statistical tests.
- Use a Kruskal-Wallis test because house avlues were not normally sitributed and did not have equal variance across cities. 
- Found that house values differed significantly across the 18 cities.
